title: Persistent magnitude homology on finite metric space
summary: Magnitude homology is an emerging approach that captures the intrinsic topological and geometric features of metric spaces. It offers a distinct theoretical lens for interpreting structural information within topological and geometric data analysis. This work introduces persistent magnitude homology, an extension of magnitude homology that captures multi-scale geometric and topological features of metric spaces.
